high_level_description: The image shows the exterior of an Indian Overseas Bank branch in Lucknow. The bank's signboard is prominently displayed at the top of the building. The signboard is blue with white text that reads "Indian Overseas Bank" in both English and Hindi. Below the main text, there is additional smaller text that appears to be related to the bank's services or location. The building itself has a classical architectural style with columns and a balcony. There is a railing in front of the entrance, which is partially visible in the image.
